queues.// batchSize/maxDequeueCount: Shared by ALL queue-triggered functions in this Function App (seat-hold-queue, order-created, order-created-poison) — host.json queue settings are global, not per-queue. batchSize=1 is required for seat-hold-queue to keep the on-sale-moment concurrency window as small as possible (research.md §1); applying it to order-created too is an acceptable MVP tradeoff (slightly lower fulfillment throughput per instance, still scales via multiple instances). Splitting into separate Function Apps for independent tuning is a future optimization, not needed for launch (see tasks.md T039).
